_comment: Single source of truth for the universal moon-phase housing. ALL geometry in build_housing.py comes from this file. Provenance per field: 'vendor' = Waveshare dimension drawings / STEP (hardware/moonv1/parts/vendor/, fetched by get_vendor.py), 'product-image' = official Waveshare product photos, 'docs' = repo docs/tools/fit*.json or docs/devices/*.rst, 'derived' = computed from other fields, 'assumed' = design assumption to be confirmed by the A2 test print (recorded then moved to 'measured').

print.tol_note: FDM 0.2 mm PETG: 0.20 mm radial clearance default; A2 records per-seat measured clearance here under 'measured'.

housing.base_od_note: P4 board OD 126.00 + 4 mm wall + 2 mm lip = 134.0
housing.tilt_note: Desk-stand tilt of the cradle face; 15-20 deg design band from the plan. 18 chosen for the ~160 mm height cap.

backstop_box_mm.note: Backstop strut box (y 20..74, z 8..70, x -25..25): overlaps the base top (z>=10) AND the faceplate back (verified against the tilted face plane at the chosen 18 deg tilt). Extends to y 74, beyond the base OD 134/2=67 — by design, the strut reaches up to the faceplate back at the tilt; the audit checks the +Y extent against this box.

housing.usb_c_cut_note: Standard USB-C receptacle (9 x 11.35 mm body) with 0.75 mm relief each side on width. The channel's HEIGHT is the seat's board thickness (the board seats display-face at the pocket front); its radial extent is the pocket wall (pocket_r..face_ring). Through-cut at each seat's measured USB-C angle.
housing.screw_note: ANTI-FLEX RULE (highest-priority mechanical rule, from the knob brown-out field history - overtightened case screws flexed the PCB / pinched ground and the display had to be unpressed): exactly ONE M2.5 press-fit screw per seat, printed boss with 0.10 mm clearance thread, max 0.5 N.m, landing on a vendor mounting hole on a non-display, non-battery board corner. Never screw through or clamp on the display.

s3.board_stack_note: Side-view max component height from the dimension drawing; the board face sits at 2.05 mm (module) with components down to 10.40 mm below the display plane on the rear side.
s3.display_rim_r_note: docs/tools/fit.json R_rim_mm (product-photo fit); equals board_od/2 within 0.00 - the display ring coincides with the board OD on this board.
s3.face_ring_id_note: va_od 44.16 + 1.40 rim cover (bezel 2.60 - 1.20 lip); the faceplate ring closes 1.20 mm inside the board OD, overlapping the bezel. Ring OD 66 = face disc r 33.
s3.screw_holes_note: 3x M2.00 holes ('3M*2.00-H3.5'), 34 deg marks; measured off the 300 dpi rear view anchored to the 24.48 mm outline circle, accuracy +/-0.25 mm; polar R~18.0/18.1/17.6 deg -1/141/-139. A2 verifies against the physical board.
s3.screw_pick_note: Anti-flex landing: the right-edge hole - furthest from the display (R 18.0 vs VA r 22.08), clear of the LiPo bay (bottom edge) and the 8-pin header (left edge).

usbc.note: Bottom edge per the rear view; radial position from the USB-C body center, A2 verifies with the physical board.

battery_bay.note: S3 AMOLED 1.75 has no on-board cell (board stack is PCB + module only).

p4.board_od_note: Official product dimension image (4C-details-size-1) + the DXF outer ring r=63.0. The 4C zip's 86 mm drawing pages are the display sub-module, not the main board.
p4.board_stack_note: Total stack 15.00 - display protrusion 6.00 (official 4C dimension image: 15.00 total, 6.00 face).
p4.display_rim_r_note: docs/tools/fit_p4.json R_rim_mm - product-photo fit of the 720 display rim (50.76/63.0 mm photo circles scale to 25.38/31.5 mm content/rim on the 4.0 inch panel); use for the face-ring geometry only.
p4.face_ring_id_note: Glass plate OD 102.95 + 0.05 gap: the 4C face ring closes at the glass edge (the glass is a flat plate to the rim, unlike the S3's bezel step). Ring OD = collar 65.8 x2.
p4.pocket_depth_note: board_stack 9.00 + microSD/connector relief 3.00 + 0.20 clearance. The P4 board rear is dense (microSD, battery header, C6) - the seat bottom never touches.
p4.screw_holes_note: 4x M4.00 holes ('4M*4.00') on a 75x75 mm square centered on the board (R 53.03, inside the 63.00 board OD), from the vendor DXF circle centers + the dimension drawing's 37.50/10.00/17.00 callouts.
p4.screw_pick_note: Anti-flex landing: bottom-right hole - clear of the display (R 53.03 vs glass r 51.48), clear of the battery header (right) and microSD (top). M4 hole receives the M2.5 screw via a printed boss sleeve (A2 verifies the engagement).

usbc.note: Left edge per the rear view; radial position from the USB-C body center, A2 verifies.

battery_bay.note: P4 4C battery rides a header (rear view, right side) - no cell in the seat; the seat bottom relief (pocket_depth) clears the header.

knob.case_note: Official Waveshare outline-dimensions photo (ESP32-S3-Knob-Touch-LCD-1.8-details-size.jpg): the stock CNC case is 66.00 x 22.00 mm; the user's knob board lives in that case, so the seat is a well for the stock case, not the bare board.
knob.panel_od_note: 360x360 1.8 inch panel: active square 45.4 mm diagonal 64.2 mm minus bezel; nominal 57.6 mm - A2 verifies against the physical case.
knob.pocket_depth_note: case_height 22.00 + 0.20 clearance; the case bottom is the seat bottom (press fit, no screw - the stock case's own screw pattern is the documented brown-out hazard).
knob.screw_holes_note: NONE. Anti-flex rule: the knob seat is press-fit only. The stock case screws flexed the PCB (docs/devices/knob.rst brown-out history) - the new housing replaces that with a friction fit + one friction shoulder, zero screw torque on the knob seat.

usbc.note: USB-C on the case rim (official photo); A2 verifies angle/radial against the physical case.

battery_bay.note: Cell lives inside the stock CNC case (3.7V 102035 variant) - the seat well contains it.

moonv1.board_od_note: PROPOSED Moon v1 board (hardware/moonv1/): round outline <= 55 mm from the plan. Stub seat from nominal values; regenerated from the real KiCad STEP after Phase B2 (the closed loop).
moonv1.display_od_note: Same 1.75 inch CO5300 module as the S3 board - the Moon v1 reuses the proven FPC interface.
moonv1.board_stack_note: Moon v1: PCB + module only (no external LiPo on-board; cell in the housing bay) - A2/Phase B revises from the STEP.
moonv1.screw_pick_note: Self-designed board: landing at r 25 - outside the display keep-out (glass r 22.08 + 1.0 = 23.08) and inside the pocket r 27.7. The KiCad layout must put an M2.5 counterbore there (anti-flex rule: exactly one, non-display, non-battery corner).

battery_bay.note: Moon v1 carries the LiPo in the housing (MX1.25 pad on the board); bay sized A2.

battery_bays.note: External LiPo bays in the base (S3 AMOLED has no cell; Moon v1 will carry one). One 18650-length slot per design iteration is out of scope; the bay is for a 502503-class cell + MX1.25 connector, sized A2. Placeholder geometry below is a 50x25x20 mm slot at the base rear, A2 replaces with measured cell dims.
